title: Snake wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snake body: green S curve -->
  <path d='M20 82 Q10 62 26 54 Q44 45 44 33 Q44 22 58 22' stroke='#3ddc55' stroke-width='13' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body shading/segment stripes -->
  <path d='M20 82 Q10 62 26 54 Q44 45 44 33 Q44 22 58 22' stroke='#7cf094' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-dasharray='3 9' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='24' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#3ddc55' transform='rotate(18 66 24)'/>
  <!-- snout highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='24' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#5cee70' transform='rotate(18 66 24)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='19' r='3.4' fill='#1a3a22'/>
  <circle cx='68.8' cy='18.2' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='27' r='3.4' fill='#1a3a22'/>
  <circle cx='77.8' cy='26.2' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M70 31 Q74 35 79 31' stroke='#1a3a22' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M79 32 L87 34 M87 34 L85 30 M87 34 L85 38' stroke='#ff5b8a' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- party hat -->
  <path d='M54 14 L62 -2 L70 14 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <path d='M58 8 L66 8' stroke='#ff5b8a' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56.5 11.5 L67.5 11.5' stroke='#4ad6ff' stroke-width='2.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='-1' r='3' fill='#ff5b8a'/>
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <path d='M52 14 Q62 18 72 14' stroke='#4ad6ff' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
